name: Trek to Ashenvale

meta.previous: Escape Through Stealth or Escape Through Force

summary: Sentinel Selarin sends travelers south from Auberdine into Ashenvale. There, you report to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar, where the Sentinels face spreading corruption.

sections.title: Leaving the Coast
sections.body: Sentinel Selarin's call for aid brings you from Auberdine, on Darkshore's somber gray coast, toward the night elf lands to the south. The Sentinel trusts capable fighters and scouts to make the journey into the heart of that territory. With local threats in Darkshore handled, the greater perils of Ashenvale now demand attention.

sections.title: The Road to Astranaar
sections.body: An ancient night elf road winds south beneath Ashenvale's dense canopy. Raene Wolfrunner, who leads the Sentinels in Astranaar, has urgently called for reinforcements. Demonic taints, rampant wildlife, and incursions from beyond ancestral lands have stretched the defenders thin. They need outside aid to hold the sacred forest.

faq.q: Who sends you on this trek?
faq.answer: Sentinel Selarin, a night elf sentinel sent to Auberdine by Raene Wolfrunner to seek help, directs you south toward Astranaar.
Raene Wolfrunner leads the Sentinels in Astranaar. She organizes Ashenvale's defense and coordinates efforts against the corruption afflicting the forest.

faq.q: Why are adventurers being sent to Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Spreading corruption and mounting threats from beyond Ashenvale's borders are overwhelming the local night elf Sentinels. They urgently need capable allies to aid Astranaar's citizens and defenders.

faq.q: Is the road between Darkshore and Ashenvale safe?
faq.answer: Sentinel Selarin advises you to stay close to the road. The deep woods hold aggressive predators, satyrs, and hostile forces along the untamed borders.

faq.q: What should I do upon arriving in Astranaar?
faq.answer: Report directly to Raene Wolfrunner when you reach Astranaar. She advises you to speak with the town's residents and defenders, many of whom need immediate aid with local crises.

faq.q: What level of adventurer is this intended for?
faq.answer: This journey usually marks your departure from Darkshore around level nineteen. It carries intermediate adventurers into Ashenvale's broader, more contested frontier.

angles.text: As a night elf, you return to Kalimdor's sacred heartland, where your sisters call for help protecting ancient holy grounds from unnatural rot.
As an Alliance champion, you answer Astranaar's call, strengthening ties with the night elves and shoring up the Alliance's primary foothold in northern Kalimdor.
